name: AionUi

overview_markdown:
AionUi is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0) Electron desktop application that positions itself as a 24/7 'cowork' app for AI coding agents. Rather than being an agent itself, it provides a unified GUI on top of OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and 20+ other CLI agents, letting users customize assistants, team multiple agents together, and run them continuously with remote access. It ships cross-platform builds for macOS, Windows, and Linux with 13-language localization.

Architecturally, it pairs a TypeScript/Electron front end with a companion 'aioncore' backend, integrating agents via ACP and MCP protocols. Recent commits show mature product engineering: tab-scoped explorer refresh with repository re-discovery, VS Code-style collapse-all, distinct waiting-for-user conversation states with desktop notifications, and websocket reconnection hardening—signs of an actively maintained, production-grade codebase at v2.2.2.

Compared to OpenClaw itself, AionUi is a complement and alternative front-end rather than a competing agent runtime: it trades OpenClaw's lean, hackable footprint for accessibility, multi-agent orchestration UI, and zero-setup onboarding. Its 33k stars and frequent release cadence make it the most visible GUI in the OpenClaw ecosystem, though users needing strong sandboxing or headless server deployment should look elsewhere.
